reason: When I get anxious or lonely late at night, I can already open ChatGPT or Claude for free, so on a $13,000 student budget I can't justify paying for an AI chat app.
objection: Free ChatGPT or Claude can already listen to me vent late at night without charging me a monthly subscription.
would_change_my_mind: A solid free tier for late-night venting or a student discount around $2 to $3 a month.
